hero_text: Al Jamia Arts and Science College moulds students into professionally competent, socially responsible and morally sound citizens — affiliated to the University of Calicut and recognised by the Government of Kerala.
principal_name: Dr. (Lt. Cdr. Rtd.) C. K. Abdul Rabbi Nistar
principal_excerpt: It gives me immense pleasure to lead an institution that stands at the confluence of tradition and modernity. At AJASC we firmly believe that education is not merely about academic achievement but about building character, inspiring purpose and transforming lives.
